patterns.note: Prominent use of full-bleed, high-quality product photography as hero images and background elements for content sections.
Grid-based display for product collections and service offerings, utilizing image cards with subtle text overlays or captions.
A clear typographic hierarchy established by pairing a classic serif font for main headings with a clean sans-serif for body text and sub-headings.
A sophisticated, muted color palette dominated by deep neutrals (black, dark grey, off-white) accented by rich, metallic tones derived directly from product imagery (gold, bronze, deep jewel tones).
The header navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and becoming sticky at the top of the viewport with a solid background.
The main hero image exhibits a subtle parallax or scaling effect as the user scrolls down, creating a sense of depth and movement.
Editorial-style content blocks featuring large, immersive imagery paired with concise descriptive text, often presented in a two-column or split layout.

technique_notes: The primary navigation bar is initially transparent and full-height, then transitions to a reduced height, opaque, sticky bar with a subtle background as the user scrolls past the hero section.
The hero section features a large, full-width image that subtly scales down or shifts its position relative to the scroll, creating a gentle parallax effect.
Content sections below the hero appear to reveal or fade in as they enter the viewport, creating a guided scrolling experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller, often uppercase, sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Mostly sharp corners, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and image cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a clean, open feel within content blocks.

standout: The site's standout feature is its sophisticated integration of high-end product photography with a refined, editorial layout. The design effectively uses large, immersive images and a classic-meets-modern typography pairing to convey luxury and craftsmanship, making the watches feel like art pieces rather than mere products.
